description: The PrestoDB comparison ran over tpch.tiny, where 80 of the variants return a single row and 30 return two, so wrong grouping or aggregation would often go unnoticed. The reference was DuckDB loaded from the same Presto-generated tables, which use DOUBLE prices, not the DECIMAL schema BenchBox generates. Row-order handling only checks for a top-level ORDER BY in the DuckDB text and does not tell ties from a wrong order.
